events.verdict: Anthony (ORL) adjusts along Morant's (MEM) path when marginal contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact that occurs during Morant's (MEM) driving shot attempt.
Anthony (ORL) extends his arms slightly as he releases his screening position when marginal contact occurs with Bane (MEM), which does not affect Bane's ability to maintain his defensive positioning.
Morant (MEM) goes to, not through, Anthony's (ORL) space and marginal contact occurs as Morant releases away as he gathers into his step-back move.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
As Wagner (ORL) attempts to turn, he brings the ball into Clarke's (MEM) knee and the contact dislodges the ball prior to incidental contact occurring.
Anthony (ORL) slides his hand off Jackson Jr. (MEM) as Jackson Jr. completes his intended pass on the perimeter.
Anthony (ORL) takes a slight step laterally into Bane's (MEM) path while also bringing his right arm around Bane's back, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Aldama (MEM) brings his arm toward Banchero's (ORL) path and marginal contact occurs during Banchero's drive.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds and Orlando correctly retains the possession.
Bane (MEM) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Clarke (MEM) rests his hands on Carter Jr. (ORL) and releases when incidental lower-body contact also occurs with Jackson Jr. (MEM) as they come together.
Banchero (ORL) commits a take foul on Aldama (MEM).
Clarke (MEM) moves alongside Banchero's (ORL) path toward the basket when marginal body contact occurs before Jackson Jr. (MEM) cleanly blocks the driving shot attempt.
